notes: SecurityCategory Level 1 ≈ AES‑128, Level 3 ≈ AES‑192, Level 5 ≈ AES‑256.
For TLS, prefer ML‑KEM hybrids defined in draft‑ietf‑tls‑ecdhe‑mlkem. For PKI, use LAMPS composite KEM/signature drafts where hybrids are required.
NIST standardized: ML‑KEM (FIPS 203), ML‑DSA (FIPS 204), SLH‑DSA (FIPS 205). In 2025 NIST selected HQC for standardization; BIKE was not selected.
FrodoKEM was an alternate and was not selected; it remains of interest in some jurisdictions for conservative (unstructured LWE) assumptions.
Falcon (FN‑DSA) is expected as a forthcoming FIPS; check NIST for the latest draft status.
